The people of Tortuga fled the city after the undead invasion and raised a desperate camp around the late governor's mansion. Amid the chaos, they cling to this battered refuge and fight to survive another day.

A rough stronghold of the Brethren of the Coast, held together by old oaths, gunpowder, and stubborn pride. Its people have lost much, but they have not yet surrendered the sea.

Willing to buy the following goods:
Naval Supplies, Specialized Tools

Hidden from Blackbeard's spies and beyond the reach of the undead, the smugglers' camp remains one of the last safe havens in the archipelago. From here, vital goods still slip through the blockade.

Willing to buy the following goods:
Contraband, Luxuries

Having refused to side with Blackbeard, the buccaneers have become his prey. Their camp is little more than a hard-bitten refuge for hunters and fighters who still refuse to bend the knee.

Willing to buy the following goods:
Spirits, Munitions

Once a thriving haven for privateers and every kind of scoundrel, Tortuga now lies in the grip of the undead. Even so, a few stubborn souls still trade, drink, and resist, refusing to abandon their home.
